figs.name: impedance-and-reactance-series-rlc-circuit-diagram
figs.alt: series RLC circuit with 30 ohm resistor, 0.2 H inductor and 50 uF capacitor on 230 V
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the series RLC circuit from the worked example: 30 ohm, 0.2 H and 50 uF on a 230 V, 50 Hz supply.
figs.after_h2: Impedance and Reactance in AC Circuits: Key Concepts

<line x1="630" y1="190" x2="690" y2="190" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="4"/>

<text x="620" y="205" font-size="18" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">C = 50 µF</text>

figs.name: impedance-and-reactance-calculation-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to calculate inductive reactance, capacitive reactance, impedance and current
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the steps to calculate XL, XC, net reactance, impedance, phase angle and current in a series RLC circuit.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to calculate impedance and reactance step by step</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How to Calculate Impedance Step by Step</text>
<rect x="250" y="60" width="300" height="50" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="91.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Know R, L, C, f and V</text>
<line x1="330" y1="110" x2="240" y2="130" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="470" y1="110" x2="560" y2="130" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="90" y="132" width="280" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="167.0" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XL = 2πfL</text>
<rect x="430" y="132" width="280" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="570.0" y="167.0" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XC = 1 ÷ (2πfC)</text>
<line x1="230" y1="188" x2="360" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="570" y1="188" x2="440" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="225" width="300" height="50" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="256.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">X = XL minus XC</text>
<line x1="400" y1="275" x2="400" y2="300" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,300.0 540.0,345 400,390.0 260.0,345" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="351.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sign of X?</text>
<line x1="260" y1="345" x2="180" y2="345" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="20" y="320" width="160" height="50" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100.0" y="339.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">X > 0</text>
<text x="100.0" y="362.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">inductive</text>
<line x1="540" y1="345" x2="620" y2="345" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="620" y="320" width="160" height="50" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="700.0" y="339.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">X < 0</text>
<text x="700.0" y="362.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">capacitive</text>
<text x="400" y="412" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">X = 0 means resonance, Z = R</text>
<line x1="400" y1="420" x2="400" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="170" y="440" width="460" height="50" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="471.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Z = √(R² + X²) and φ = arctan(X ÷ R)</text>
<line x1="400" y1="490" x2="400" y2="505" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="300" y="505" width="200" height="44" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="533.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">I = V ÷ Z</text>
</svg>

figs.name: impedance-and-reactance-worked-example-infographic
figs.alt: impedance and reactance worked example results XL 62.83 ohm XC 63.66 ohm Z 30.01 ohm
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog summarising the worked example: XL 62.83 ohm, XC 63.66 ohm, net reactance, impedance 30.01 ohm, phase angle and 7.66 A current.
figs.after_h2: Worked Impedance and Reactance Calculation Example
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 470" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Worked example results for impedance and reactance</title>
<rect width="800" height="470" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked Example Results at 50 Hz</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="230" height="155" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="145" y="112" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XL</text>
<text x="145" y="158" font-size="26" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">62.83 Ω</text>
<text x="145" y="198" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2π × 50 × 0.2</text>
<rect x="280" y="70" width="230" height="155" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="395" y="112" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">XC</text>
<text x="395" y="158" font-size="26" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">63.66 Ω</text>
<text x="395" y="198" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1 ÷ (2π × 50 × 0.00005)</text>
<rect x="530" y="70" width="230" height="155" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="645" y="112" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">X</text>
<text x="645" y="158" font-size="26" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">minus 0.83 Ω</text>
<text x="645" y="198" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">slightly capacitive</text>
<rect x="30" y="245" width="230" height="155" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="145" y="287" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Z</text>
<text x="145" y="333" font-size="26" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">30.01 Ω</text>
<text x="145" y="373" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">√(30² + 0.83²)</text>
<rect x="280" y="245" width="230" height="155" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="395" y="287" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">φ</text>
<text x="395" y="333" font-size="26" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">minus 1.6°</text>
<text x="395" y="373" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">power factor near 1</text>
<rect x="530" y="245" width="230" height="155" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="645" y="287" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">I</text>
<text x="645" y="333" font-size="26" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">7.66 A</text>
<text x="645" y="373" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">230 ÷ 30.01</text>
<text x="400" y="440" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">R = 30 Ω, L = 0.2 H, C = 50 µF, V = 230 V, f = 50 Hz</text>
</svg>
